question: Who was recently honored with the prestigious Ramon Magsaysay Award, often referred to as Asia's Nobel Prize, in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hayao Miyazaki**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ****Hayao Miyazaki**, co-founder of Studio Ghibli, was honored with the 2024 Ramon Magsaysay Award, often referred to as Asia's Nobel Prize.**
 
• Miyazaki is a renowned film director known for critically acclaimed movies such as *Spirited Away*, *My Neighbor Totoro*, *Princess Mononoke*, and *Howl's Moving Castle*.
 
• **The award recognizes individuals and organizations that have significantly impacted Asia. It was created in tribute to former Philippine President Ramon Magsaysay.**
 
• Miyazaki was praised for using art to help children understand complex issues like environmental conservation and promoting peace through his animated films.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Studio Ghibli, co-founded by Miyazaki, recently became the first group to be awarded the honorary Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival.
 
• Miyazaki came out of retirement to create *The Boy and the Heron*, which received critical acclaim and won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
 
• The Ramon Magsaysay Award ceremony will be held in Manila in November 2024.
